resolved_issues.title: [Bug]: `unstable_patchRoutesOnMiss` remote module error-handling
Routes formatted as `$foo-bar` are being prioritised over routes formatted as `foo-bar`.
resolved_issues.body:
### Reproduction

1. Go to this reproduction on [StackBlitz](https://stackblitz.com/edit/remix-run-remix-kieblg?file=package.json)
2. Visit `/pages/foo-bar`

### System Info

```shell
System:
    OS: Linux 5.0 undefined
    CPU: (8) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9880H CPU @ 2.30GHz
    Memory: 0 Bytes / 0 Bytes
    Shell: 1.0 - /bin/jsh
  Binaries:
    Node: 18.18.0 - /usr/local/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.22.19 - /usr/local/bin/yarn
    npm: 9.4.2 - /usr/local/bin/npm
    pnpm: 8.10.5 - /usr/local/bin/pnpm
  npmPackages:
    @remix-run/css-bundle: * => 2.4.1 
    @remix-run/dev: * => 2.4.1 
    @remix-run/node: * => 2.4.1 
    @remix-run/react: * => 2.4.1 
    @remix-run/serve: * => 2.4.1
```


### Used Package Manager

npm

### Expected Behavior

In the case where there are routes using `pages.$foo-bar.tsx` and `pages.foo-bar.tsx` routes, I would expect `/pages/foo-bar` to match with the `pages.foo-bar.tsx` file, not the `pages.$foo-bar.tsx` file.

### Actual Behavior

When visiting `/pages/foo-bar`, the `pages.$foo-bar.tsx` file is matched over the `pages.foo-bar.tsx` file.
